vulnerability.name: USN-9054-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Babel incorrectly evaluated certain code during compilation when used with certain plugins. If a user or an automated system were tricked into compiling specially crafted code, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: Babel could be made to run programs as your login if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
